g.text: Grain variability and branch contrasts in the retained IROF sample
30 selected correct grains; six categories × five grains; 29 section keys. No per-grain AOC is truncated.
B1 = GMAS_LOTE; B2 = GMAS_LOTE2. GC = Grad-CAM; CB/CC = Chefer branch/cross adaptations; CA = cross-attention; RO = rollout.
Panel B: black = equal-section mean; thick = pointwise 95%; grey = simultaneous 95% (41 contrasts), under section exchangeability.
Mask pixel areas, per-grain curves and individual null-order variation are unavailable. Section groups may share unknown parents.
